name: S-WIKI
title: Resource Plan
params_text:
The TRDC (IT) Resource Plan is coordinated by the China Service Desk prior to each public holiday. To ensure the stability of the ERP system during holiday periods, we require each department to submit their resource plan in advance.

Key requirements include:

  • Support Coverage: Each support team must ensure that at least 50% of their staff are either on duty or on-call during the holiday.
  • Domain Standby: Every support domain must have designated standby personnel available to respond to any critical issues.

This proactive planning helps maintain operational continuity and minimizes the risk of service disruptions during holiday periods.

name: S-WIKI
title: Rebate Factor
params_text:
The Rebate Factor is a value used to calculate the actual rebate amount for different types of rebates .
1) If rebate type is C, R, W, the rebate factor can\u2019t be more than 100, set it to 100 if user input a number which more than 100.
2) If rebate type is C, R, W,F, the pass thru rebate factor can\u2019t be more than(>=) claimable rebate factor, set pass thru rebate factor to blank if it more than claimable rebate factor;
3) If rebate type is B, A, the pass thru rebate factor can\u2019t be less than (<=)claimable rebate factor, set pass thru rebate factor to blank if it less than claimable rebate factor;
4) If rebate type is F, and rebate factor is more than min price and base cost of sku, set rebate factor to larger one of min price and base cost.
5) Calculate rebate amt when user change this value.
Calculation: The Rebate Factor can be used in formulas such as:
For type C (% of PO Cost): rebate amount = base cost * rebate factor%
For type R (% of Retail Price): rebate amount = retail price * rebate factor%
For type F (Flat $ Amount): The rebate factor equals the flat rebate amount.<\/p>
